reason: A media utility plugin that adds agent tools and a settings panel for recognizing, describing, and OCR-processing local images or clipboard screenshots through a locally hosted LM Studio vision model.

summaries.zh: 通过本地 LM Studio 视觉模型识别、描述和 OCR 处理本地图片或剪贴板截图，并提供智能体工具与设置面板。
summaries.en: Uses a locally hosted LM Studio vision model to recognize, describe, and OCR local images or clipboard screenshots through agent tools and a settings panel.

capabilities: Reads local image files by absolute path
Reads the current clipboard image on Windows
Sends image data to a locally configured LM Studio server for vision recognition and OCR
Provides agent tools and a settings panel
Stores configuration in a user config file
